priyanka: Heads-up: Im opening a small docs PR to replace old autoscale examples with a single scalepolicy migration guide + minimal SDK snippets. Also spotted a 404 on the terraform examples link. Who can help review?
emma: Ill take the SLA wording and autoscale->scalepolicy narrative. Quick confirm: reserved pools SLA 99.95, preemptible guidance 99.9, correct?
ryan: Correct. Ill handle the Go snippet and fix the terraform link. Paste the broken URL and Ill add a redirect.
javier: Ill add tenant-isolation edge cases (eviction -> fallback, cooldown delays) with expected HTTP error codes.
priyanka: Broken URL: https://handbook.redwood.ai/provisioning/terraform/examples. Draft YAML I plan to include: ```yaml
scalepolicy:
  name: tenant-scalepolicy-v2
  kind: percent-surge
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 16
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  eviction_behavior: fallback_to_variant
```
emma: Nice. Add one line about cost impact when enabling KV/prefix caching.
ryan: Will push link fix + small README change in examples repo.
docs-bot: Created issue #823 for the 404 and tagged docs/link-fixes.
priyanka: Opening PR now with three commits: migration example, SDK snippets (py+go), link fix. Reviewers: emma, ryan. Will follow up with PR link.
